authority: Bounded shadow-recording/report source review and existing focused fixture suite
reviewedBehavior: Only passed or failed lane executions become fresh shadow observations; reused and not-run lanes are excluded.
The recorder derives keys and performs lookupAll before appending the batch of observations and facts.
A hit decision paired with a failed observation is a disagreement.
Known changed packages block reuse when they intersect lane package scope. An unavailable changed set blocks scoped lanes; this does not manufacture scope for undeclared inputs.
The enforcement report selects its configured stage/profile pair and optional recordedAt >= since bound. Invalid timestamps are excluded from a bounded sample.
Headline counts retain all rows. Enforcement readiness uses only the filtered sample and configured attempt, branch and disagreement thresholds.
inputs: Lane run reports including status, command, declared input digest and package scope
Existing clone proof ledger and proof epoch
Current time, attempt identity, branch, stage and environment profile
Report since bound and enforcement thresholds
limits: One batch reads decisions before its own append; cross-process locking, atomicity and races are not proven here.
An enforcement-ready shadow report is not completion of this qualification goal or signed remote evidence.
Complete Git discovery, epoch, persistence and downstream decision semantics remain outside this bounded review.
